step0.title: Welcome to Koma Studio
step0.desc: This is an AI-powered short drama creation tool. Let's quickly learn the core workflow: from script to finished video in just three steps.

step1.title: Step 1: Create a Project
step1.desc: Click "New Project" to start creating. Choose between short drama or narration mode, and set the visual style.

step2.title: Step 2: Configure AI Services
step2.desc: In Global Settings, configure LLM (script analysis), TTI (text-to-image), ITV (image-to-video), and TTS (text-to-speech) services. These are the foundation for content generation.

step3.title: Three-Step Workflow
step3.desc: Once inside a project, follow the three-step workflow: Asset Management, AI Storyboard, and Post-Production Editing. Each step is AI-assisted.

step4.title: Start Creating!
step4.desc: Now you understand the basic workflow. Create your first project and experience the magic of AI-powered short drama creation. You can revisit this guide anytime from Settings.
